comment: The toolchains of the repository that no other file declares. npm is declared in devEngines.packageManager of package.json, Rust with its targets in rust-toolchain.toml and PHP in .php-version. mise is the release that make install-tools TOOLS=npm installs with the sha256 of each platform of the deployment targets; mise.toml declares the tools it installs (Node.js, npm, Go, Python, Composer and the wasm-bindgen CLI) and mise.lock locks them. The releases are those of binding.
